model.title: Cold Weather Diesel Reliability Act of 2025
model.meta: Environment and Public Works Committee · Sen. Dan Sullivan (R-AK)

summary.text: The bill would require the EPA to allow manufacturers of certain vehicles to temporarily disable engine shutdown or power-reduction features during extended cold weather periods. This aims to improve diesel vehicle reliability and performance in harsh winter conditions while those protective functions are suspended.
